### Masters of Science - Health Care Admimistration, Health/Health Care Administration/Management at [Central Michigan University](https://www.linkedin.com/school/central-michigan-university)

Mt. Pleasant, Michigan, United States

Central Michigan University is a higher education institution. Central Michigan University is a university that offers hands-on learning and career support to its students. They provide job offers and grad school acceptance within 6 months after graduation. They also offer campus tours and student guides. Central Michigan University has 3,000-4,000 employees (+1-2% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $200M-$300M range, founded in 1892. Headquartered in Mt. Pleasant, Michigan, United States, with presence in Mexico. Its workforce is distributed across 27 countries (including United States, India, Canada, Romania, and Pakistan). Has $31.9M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

### Bachelor's Degree, Psychology at [Kennesaw State University](https://www.linkedin.com/school/kennesaw-state-university)

Kennesaw, Georgia, United States

Kennesaw State University is a higher education institution. Kennesaw State University is an innovative institution in teaching and learning, offering undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degrees across two metro Atlanta campuses. It is a member of the University System of Georgia and the third-largest university in Georgia. Kennesaw State University has 4,000-5,000 employees (+5-6% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $500M-$600M range, founded in 1963. Headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia, United States, with offices in Marietta and Acworth. Its workforce is distributed across 19 countries (including United States, Bangladesh, India, Canada, and Georgia). Has $311.8K in total funding, with 1 prior funding round. Research output of 10,000-20,000 works, primarily in Social Sciences, Business, Management and Accounting, and Computer Science. Funds research behind 10-20 works.

personal_hooks.fact: Gaye Pennington holds a Bachelor's Degree in Psychology from Kennesaw State University and a Master of Science in Health Care Administration from Central Michigan University.

personal_hooks.verbatim_quote: Today, we proudly honor our CEO, Gaye Pennington, for an incredible 25 years of dedicated service at Digestive Healthcare of Georgia.
personal_hooks.fact: In January 2026, Digestive Healthcare of Georgia celebrated Gaye Pennington's 25 years of service.

suggested_openers.opener: It has been an incredible journey reaching your 25-year milestone with Digestive Healthcare of Georgia—what an inspiring legacy of leadership you have built.
